name: Airtable
description: Trigger workflows from new or updated Airtable records, and create, update, upsert, delete or read records and base schemas from a step.

triggers.label: A record is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each record created in the table since the last poll, oldest first.

env.name: AIRTABLE_API_KEY
env.description: A personal access token from airtable.com/create/tokens with the scopes data.records:read, data.records:write and schema.bases:read, granted access to each base it should reach.
env.builderHint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer on every call. Scopes are not enough: the token lists the bases it may touch, and one it was not granted answers 403 or 404. There is no Airtable CLI to borrow a login from.

env.name: AIRTABLE_BASE_ID
env.description: The base the triggers watch, app… from the base URL or listBases.
env.builderHint: Only the triggers read it; every action takes its own baseId input.

env.name: AIRTABLE_TABLE
env.description: The table the triggers watch, by id (tbl…) or by name.
env.builderHint: A name is URL-encoded into the path; an id also lets each item carry a record URL.

env.name: AIRTABLE_VIEW
env.description: A view name or id to watch. Records hidden by the view are skipped. Blank for the whole table.
env.builderHint: Sent as view on the listRecords body; records come back in the view’s order and its filters apply.

env.name: AIRTABLE_FILTER_BY_FORMULA
env.description: An extra Airtable formula a record must satisfy, such as {Status} = "Open".
env.builderHint: ANDed with the time clause each poll sends: AND(NOT(IS_BEFORE(CREATED_TIME(), DATETIME_PARSE("…"))), <formula>).

env.name: AIRTABLE_LAST_MODIFIED_FIELD
env.description: The name of a "Last modified time" field in the table, for the updated-record trigger. Blank falls back to LAST_MODIFIED_TIME() and the poll time.
env.builderHint: The list response has no modification time, so without this field the trigger stamps each record with the poll time and fires once per poll a record was touched in; with it the cell value is the item’s updatedAt and the sort key.

triggers.label: A record is updated
triggers.description: Fires for each record modified since the last poll. Name a last-modified-time field to stamp items with the real time; without one the poll time stands in.

actions.label: Create a record
actions.description: Add one record to a table.

inputs.label: Base
inputs.description: The base id, app…, from the base URL or listBases.
inputs.builderHint: The first path segment of every record route; the token must have been granted access to this base when it was created.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: Table id (tbl…) or table name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the second path segment; a name works but only an id lets the connector build a record URL.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: An object of cell values keyed by field name or id to set, e.g. {"Name":"Union Square","Visited":true}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the fields object of the JSON body; a name Airtable does not know answers 422 UNKNOWN_FIELD_NAME, and a value of the wrong type 422 INVALID_VALUE_FOR_COLUMN unless typecast is set.

inputs.label: Typecast
inputs.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the field’s type, such as "3" into a number or a new option name into a select choice.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as typecast: true only when set; "automatic conversion is disabled by default to ensure data integrity".

inputs.label: Return fields by id
inputs.description: Key the returned fields by field id (fld…) instead of by name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as returnFieldsByFieldId: true only when set; field ids survive a rename, names do not.

outputs.description: Record id, rec…
When the record was created, ISO 8601
The cell values keyed by field name; empty cells are omitted
Where to open it, when the table was given by id

actions.label: Upsert records
actions.description: Create or update up to 10 records at once, matching each on the merge fields: no match creates, one match updates, several fail the call.

inputs.label: Base
inputs.description: The base id, app…, from the base URL or listBases.
inputs.builderHint: The first path segment of every record route; the token must have been granted access to this base when it was created.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: Table id (tbl…) or table name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the second path segment; a name works but only an id lets the connector build a record URL.

inputs.label: Records
inputs.description: An array of up to 10 {"fields": {…}} objects; a single object is taken as one record.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as records on PATCH {baseId}/{table}; more than 10 is refused here rather than split, because a failure mid-batch is not reported per record.

inputs.label: Fields to merge on
inputs.description: One to three field names or ids that identify a record, comma-separated or as a JSON array.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn; they act as external ids and cannot be computed fields.

inputs.label: Typecast
inputs.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the field’s type, such as "3" into a number or a new option name into a select choice.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as typecast: true only when set; "automatic conversion is disabled by default to ensure data integrity".

outputs.description: Every record touched, as { id, createdTime, fields }
The ids of records that were created
The ids of records that were updated

actions.label: List records
actions.description: List the records of a table, optionally filtered by a formula or a view, up to maxRecords across pages.

inputs.label: Base
inputs.description: The base id, app…, from the base URL or listBases.
inputs.builderHint: The first path segment of every record route; the token must have been granted access to this base when it was created.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: Table id (tbl…) or table name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the second path segment; a name works but only an id lets the connector build a record URL.

inputs.label: Filter formula
inputs.description: An Airtable formula; only records where it is truthy are returned, e.g. {Status} = "Open".
inputs.builderHint: Sent in the JSON body of POST {baseId}/{table}/listRecords, so its length is not bound by the 16,000 character URL limit.

inputs.label: View
inputs.description: A view name or id; records come back in the view’s order and hidden ones are skipped.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as view; a name is matched exactly, spaces included.

inputs.label: Maximum records
inputs.description: Total records to return across pages. Defaults to 100.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as maxRecords and enforced here as well; at most ten pages of 100 are walked in one call.

inputs.label: Page size
inputs.description: Records per request, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as pageSize; a smaller page only costs more requests against the 5 per second limit.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: Field names or ids to include, comma-separated or as a JSON array. Blank returns every field.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the fields array; the primary field is not added on its own.

inputs.label: Sort
inputs.description: An array of {"field": "Name", "direction": "asc"} objects; direction is asc or desc.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as sort; it takes field names only, so CREATED_TIME() and other formulas cannot be sorted on.

inputs.label: Return fields by id
inputs.description: Key the returned fields by field id (fld…) instead of by name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as returnFieldsByFieldId: true only when set; field ids survive a rename, names do not.

outputs.description: One entry per record: id, createdTime, fields, url
How many records came back

actions.label: List bases
actions.description: The bases the token can reach, 1000 at a time, with the permission level it holds on each.

inputs.label: Offset
inputs.description: The offset from an earlier answer, to fetch the next thousand bases.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the offset query parameter; present in the output only when another page exists.

outputs.description: One entry per base: id, name, permissionLevel (none, read, comment, edit or create)
Pass back to fetch the next page, when present

actions.label: Get a base schema
actions.description: The tables of a base with their fields and views.

inputs.label: Base
inputs.description: The base id, app…, from the base URL or listBases.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the path segment of GET meta/bases/{baseId}/tables; needs the schema.bases:read scope.

outputs.description: One entry per table: id, name, primaryFieldId, fields [{ id, name, type, options }], views [{ id, name, type }]
